response.rationale: A and B are not the same concept. A, "Booking Status", is a lifecycle state of a booking. The code in BookingRepository (node 2e3c5728fffb0180, src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts) compares the attribute against values: `(b.status === "pending" || b.status === "paid")`. B, "Booking", is the reservation itself. IceMonitorService (node f59a45a01c2ed338, src/business/iceMonitorService.ts) loops over booking entities for a session: `for (const b of this.bookings.findBySession(s.id))`. A status is a property of a booking, not another name for it. The two concepts are closely linked, but they model different things.
